title: Toast Icon Audit and Correction
sourceRef: Generated from a prompt on the Todo Roadmap page
description: Who: The AI agent, reviewed by the developer who owns the dashboard UI. What: Scan every toast in the dashboard, produce a table listing each toast's current icon next to its context (e.g. success, error, warning, info, delete confirmation), then add a recommended icon column and update the code so each toast uses its recommended icon instead of the default trash icon. Where: The toast component and every place in the dashboard codebase that triggers a toast. Why: Some toasts fall back to a trash icon that does not fit their message, which confuses users about what the notification means. When: Run the audit first and share the table for review; apply the icon changes only after the developer approves the recommended icons. How: Search the codebase for all toast calls and the default icon setting, record toast name, file location, message, context, and current icon in a table, add a recommended icon and a one-line reason for each row, then update the code to match the approved table and re-share the final table.
acceptanceCriteria: The agent delivers a table covering every toast in the codebase with columns for toast name or location, message/context, and current icon.
The table includes a recommended icon column with a short reason for each row, and the final version matches what is implemented in code.
No toast other than an actual delete confirmation displays a trash icon.
Each toast's icon is visually verified in the running dashboard and matches its context (success, error, warning, info, or delete).
